verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is an IVS EventBridge event description stating a stage publisher 'is being recorded to S3'. That implies first-party server-side recording to S3 exists, but the pack never documents how to configure it or confirms the files land in the developer's own bucket. Server-side composition (docs-7) is described only for broadcasting to a channel, not for recording. missing for 10: documentation of how to set up recording (configuration or API), explicit confirmation the files go to a customer-owned S3 bucket, details on output file formats and storage layout, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can record a session server-side and receive the files in my own storage bucket

citations.quote: A publisher has connected to the stage and is being recorded to S3.
You can use Amazon EventBridge to monitor your Amazon Interactive Video Service (IVS) streams.
